intro.speaker: Varn
intro.text: Do not be alarmed by what you see. The transformation is complete. I am no longer holding the chains — I have become them.

responses.text: What does that mean for us?

wanted_ally.speaker: Varn
wanted_ally.text: I wanted order. This is order. Whether I wanted this particular form of it — I am no longer certain I am the right one to ask.

foretold_betrayer.speaker: Varn
foretold_betrayer.text: I said a great many things. Most of them were true. Including this: I do not blame you for what you chose. You saw something I could not see in myself. That does not make you right. It makes you honest.

what_it_means.speaker: Varn
what_it_means.text: It means the dungeon's structure and I are no longer separate things. I feel every room, every corridor — every fraying thread. And I am drawing them tight. That is what it means.

responses.text: And what does it mean for us?

uncertain.speaker: Varn
uncertain.text: I have always been uncertain. I simply had more room to conceal it before. The chains do not leave much space for ambiguity now.

responses.text: What happens at the end of all this?

what_are_you.speaker: Varn
what_are_you.text: The dungeon's will made manifest. Its desire for structure, embodied. I have become what the chains always needed — not someone to hold them, but something to be them. Whether that is better is a question for afterward.

responses.text: There may not be an afterward.

no_afterward.speaker: Varn
no_afterward.text: No. There may not be. I have made my peace with that. You should make yours as well.

responses.text: I'll see you at the end.

us_specifically.speaker: Varn
us_specifically.text: It means that when you reach the deepest point of this place, I will be there. Not as an ally holding a post. As the dungeon's final assertion. You have always known this was how it would end.

what_happens_now.speaker: Varn
what_happens_now.text: You go deeper. I hold the structure together until we meet again — at the place where the dungeon ends, or where you do. There is no other path from here.

responses.text: It doesn't have to end that way.

doesnt_have_to.speaker: Varn
doesnt_have_to.text: It does. The chains have always led here — I knew it before you did. I do not resent you for what is coming. I want you to know that.

farewell.speaker: Varn
farewell.text: Go. Whatever awaits you at the bottom of this place — face it as you have faced everything else. Without flinching.
